title: CAD incident records for 20 specified CAD numbers (all ALPR-hit calls)
summary: Requests, for each of 20 specified CAD incident numbers spanning March 2025 through March 2026: (1) the incident or case report, including any assigned RMS case or report number; (2) the CAD event chronology, unit history, or dispatch log for the call, as distinct from the narrative report; and (3) where any record is withheld, an index entry identifying it and the specific exemption asserted, including whether the underlying matter is active or closed if § 7923.600 is invoked. SMPD produced one CAD incident report per number, with "portions exempt" under § 7923.600 on all 20, and no incident or case reports. Every CAD is incident type "ALPR - AUTOMATED LICENSE PLATE READER"; 12 of the 20 closed with no case number.

policy_promises.quote: records of investigations conducted by ... any state or local police agency
policy_promises.tests: Whether the Department applies the exemption on an individualized, per-record basis rather than categorically across all 20 incidents. Answered: "portions exempt" under § 7923.600 is listed for all 20, including 12 calls closed with no case number. On 8 of them it is the only basis cited and the only visible redaction is the license plate.

policy_promises.quote: A response to a written request for inspection or copies of public records that includes a determination that the request is denied, in whole or in part, shall be in writing.
policy_promises.tests: Whether the per-record index requested in Item 3 identifies what was withheld and whether each investigation is active or closed. The index names an exemption per CAD but not what was withheld or the status of any investigation.

filed_because: Tests whether the Department can produce the underlying incident report and CAD dispatch chronology for a defined set of closed calls, and whether § 7923.600 is invoked per-record or as a blanket denial.
notes:
Closed 2026-09-24, the statutory due date, by the Senior Records Specialist. The response letter states a legal review was completed under Gov. Code § 7922.525.

Items 1 and 2: "See attached documents" for both. The production is 20 CAD incident reports, one per requested number. No incident or case report is attached, including for the 8 incidents whose CAD shows "Report Taken" and a case number (250604004, 260121023, 260124001, 260206004, 260212012, 260217014, 260228001, 260328001).

Item 3: the index lists "portions exempt pursuant to Government Code § 7923.600" for all 20 CADs, plus Gov. Code § 7922.000 and Cal. Const. art. I § 1 for 11 of them (home addresses, per the letter). It does not say what was withheld or whether any investigation is active or closed. It lists one CAD as "260280088" (the request's 2602180088).

What the CADs show: all 20 are incident type "ALPR - AUTOMATED LICENSE PLATE READER", 17 of them officer-initiated. On 8 of the 9 CADs cited only under § 7923.600, the only visible redaction is the license plate in the Vehicles field; the ninth, 2505010214, has two redacted lines in its comments/chronology. (Same day, W013439-091426 redacted plates under Cal. Const. art. I § 1 and Gov. Code § 7922.000 instead.)

12 of the 20 closed "Completed" with no case number, including:
- 2505010214: "MISREAD SILV MERC".
- 2504010009: "PLATE ON THE CORRECT VEH".
- 2508040201: "REAR PLATE READ - FRONT PLT STOLEN AND REAR STILL ON VEH - VEH APPEARS TO MATCH".
- 2507020079: "CONSENTUAL ENCOUNTER WITH THE DRIVER".
- 2602170003: "VIN and plate match. new owner, advised to head to DMV for new plates."
- 2509030186: all three occupants taken into custody ("ONE IN CUSTODY", "2ND IN CUSTODY", "3RD SUBJ IN CUSTODY"), then closed after "ALPR HIT STOLEN VEH -- ... TURNED OUT THE REPORTING PARTY REPORTED IT WRONG TO SAN JOSE PD -- OWNER OF THE VEH WAS ADVISED TO TAKE IT OUT OF SVS W SAN JOSE PD".

The other no-case calls are unable-to-locate area checks, a contact with occupants who said the vehicle was rented, and one (2510130008) with no comments or chronology.
